subject: Acme Health - SOC 2, audit logs, and DPA follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>, Priya Sharma <p.sharma@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Health - SOC 2, audit logs, and DPA follow-up

Alex / Priya - thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we have alignment.

Key pain points you called out:
- Need demonstrable audit logs and tamper-evidence for user activity to satisfy internal and external auditors.
- Data retention and deletion controls across inference requests (retain for investigation vs. delete for privacy).
- DPA terms and whether Redwood can accommodate 7+ years retention and specific audit log exports.
- Pen test / vulnerability assessment evidence for vendor security review.

Goals you described:
- Proof points to finish vendor approval by end of August.
- A technical conversation between your security team and our Solutions Eng (Vivek) about log formats and retention windows.
- Durable agreement on DPA terms and scope of incident notifications.

What we committed to (next steps):
1) I will share our SOC 2 Type II report (redwood-soc2-report-2024.pdf) and a brief SOC2 bridge letter so you can forward to your auditors.
2) I'll attach our standard DPA draft (redwood-dpa-draft.docx) and highlight clauses that typically get redlined; we can iterate.
3) Vivek will join the technical call to map required audit fields (timestamps, request IDs, model used, and request payload/response retention policy).
4) We will provide a pen-test summary / executive findings document and list of evidence items we can produce for your security review.
5) Please send procurement contact and desired contract milestones - we can prepare a streamlined mutual action plan.

Questions from our side to help prep:
- What is your minimum required retention period for audit logs (months / years)?
- Do you need raw request/response payloads retained, or are hashed/indexed records sufficient for your auditors?
- Who should Vivek coordinate with on the security-technical call (name + email)?

Attachments: redwood-soc2-report-2024.pdf (SOC 2 cover report), redwood-dpa-draft.docx (DPA template)

Proposed times for technical call:
- Tue Jul 22 between 10:00-11:30 PT
- Wed Jul 23 between 13:00-15:00 PT

I can also loop in legal if you want to start DPA redlines early. Thanks again - happy to adjust based on your timeline.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182 | https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <p.sharma@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Acme Health - SOC 2, audit logs, and DPA follow-up

On Sun, Jul 20, 2025 at 3:00 PM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Alex / Priya - thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we have alignment.

Thanks Marissa - great summary. A few clarifications from our side:
- Retention: our security/compliance team expects audit logs to be available for 13 months by default; for certain investigations we may request export for up to 7 years.
- Payloads: for PHI-protected flows we will need the ability to exclude raw response payloads from long-term retention; indexed records with request IDs, actor, timestamp, and model used should be retained.
- Evidence: we need the SOC 2 report and a brief pen-test executive summary (high-level findings + mitigation status). The SOC2 and DPA you listed sound like the right artifacts.

Procurement: procurement@acmehealth.com is the team to coordinate with for PO and contract cadence.

Technical call: Vivek joining is ideal. On our side, please coordinate with Priya (security lead) and me. Priya's calendar is open Wed Jul 23 14:00-15:00 PT - that works for us.

Attached: acme-technical-reqs.pdf (our internal checklist) - please review and let us know which items need additional discussion.

Next steps we propose:
1) You share SOC2 + pen test summary and DPA draft (Marissa).
2) Vivek and our security team (Priya) meet Wed Jul 23 14:00 PT to map required fields and retention options.
3) Procurement kick-off email to procurement@acmehealth.com to align on milestone dates.

Thanks - looking forward to the call.

-Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of IT Security
Acme Health
alex.johnson@acmehealth.com | (617) 555-0199
